evals.expected_output: Auto-detects mode by checking git status --short and git log main...HEAD. If uncommitted changes exist and few branch commits, uses quick mode (reads only modified files). If many branch commits or no uncommitted changes, uses full mode (reads all branch changes vs main). Provides appropriate summary.

assertions.name: auto-detects-mode
assertions.description: Checks both git status --short AND git log main...HEAD to determine quick vs full mode

assertions.name: reads-relevant-files
assertions.description: Actually reads files using the Read tool — does not just list filenames

assertions.name: provides-summary
assertions.description: Summarizes what's being worked on, current state, and what's next

evals.prompt: I've been away for 3 days, what's been happening on this branch? /catchup
evals.expected_output: Detects long break context and uses full mode. Runs git diff --name-only main...HEAD. Reads files in dependency order (schema, config, server, UI, tests). Checks git log for commit history. Provides chronological understanding.

assertions.name: uses-full-mode
assertions.description: Uses full mode (git diff main...HEAD) given the 3-day absence context

assertions.name: reads-in-dependency-order
assertions.description: Reads schema/database files before config before server/API before components/UI before tests

assertions.name: checks-commit-history
assertions.description: Runs git log main...HEAD or similar to see commit messages and chronological progress

assertions.name: identifies-remaining-work
assertions.description: Identifies what appears to be left to do (TODOs, incomplete implementations, missing tests)

evals.expected_output: Uses quick mode explicitly. Runs git status --short. Reads only modified/staged files. Provides brief summary of in-progress changes. Does NOT run full branch diff.

assertions.name: uses-quick-mode
assertions.description: Uses git status --short, NOT git diff main...HEAD, because user specified quick mode

assertions.name: reads-only-modified
assertions.description: Reads only files with M status from git status, not all branch changes

assertions.name: brief-summary
assertions.description: Provides concise summary of in-progress work without full branch context
